records.summary: Focuses on adapting to extreme environments, allowing the shapeshifter to survive and thrive in any terrain or biome. Tier 1 – Basic Adaptations 1.Amphibious Shift •Can breathe both air and water while transformed. •Gain swim speed equal to movement speed. 2.Burrowerʼs Resilience •Gain tremorsense (10 feet). •Can burrow at half movement speed through loose dirt or sand. 3.Climberʼs Grace •Gain a climb speed equal to movement speed. •Advantage on Athletics (Strength) checks for climbing. 4.Night Hunter •Gain darkvision (60 feet) while transformed. •Can see in magical darkness within 30 feet. Tier 2 – Specialized Adaptations 1.Cold Resistance •Gain resistance to cold damage. •Can survive extreme cold without penalties. 2.Heat Resistance •Gain resistance to fire damage. •Can survive extreme heat without penalties. 3.Aquatic Predator •Gain blindsight (30 feet) underwater. •Swim speed increases by +10 feet. 4.Echo Tracker •Gain echolocation (30 feet) in darkness or underwater. •Can sense invisible creatures within range. Tier 3 – Advanced Adaptations 1.Glider Wings •Can glide 10 feet horizontally for every 5 feet fallen. •Reduce fall damage by half.

records.summary: Different terrains and environmental conditions affect vehicle handling. records.summary: Ranged combat involves using weapons or abilities to strike targets from a distance. This system emphasizes tactical positioning, the importance of cover, and precision targeting through optional called shots. Whether launching arrows, bullets, energy blasts, or thrown objects, characters must consider visibility, movement, and the environment when engaging in ranged attacks. Ranged combat follows the standard combat sequence but introduces unique considerations: •Line of Sight is required unless using abilities that bypass it. •Cover plays a critical role in defense, offering bonuses to a targetʼs Defense Rating (DR). •Called Shots allow characters to target specific body parts at a penalty, trading accuracy for potential debilitating effects. •Mobility and Positioning influence not only offense but also defense, as characters move to gain or lose line of sight, acquire cover, or escape engagement. •Missed Attacks may interact with terrain, objects, or even unintended targets, especially in chaotic or cluttered environments. This system is designed to balance realism, cinematic flair, and mechanical flexibility. Advanced rules like hit location tables and severity effects are available but optional, allowing groups to customize their level of tactical complexity. Ranged combat rewards players who think ahead, exploit terrain, and choose their moments carefully— making it a critical part of tactical encounters in the Multiversal system.
